items.quote: I recently visited Miami Flooring and Lumber, and I could not be more impressed with the service and selection! The staff was incredibly helpful, offering expert advice and guiding me to exactly what I needed for my project.
After having visited multiple flooring stores looking for exactly what I wanted, I finally found Miami Flooring and Lumber via Google while I was in the area.
Great selection, great service. Bought porcelain tile for my home and staff was very knowledgeable on options and installation process. Highly recommend.
